title: 两两交换链表中的节点
description: 给你一个链表，每两个相邻节点交换位置。返回链表头。要求原地、O(1) 空间。
ioFormat: 第一行 n（链表长度），第二行 n 个值。输出交换后的链表，空列表则输出空行。

solutions.idea: 维护 dummy + prev，prev.next 指向当前一对的头。每次移动 prev 两次。O(L) 时间、O(1) 空间，是迭代最直白写法。
solutions.code:
import sys

class N:
    __slots__ = ('v', 'nxt')
    def __init__(self, v=0, nxt=None):
        self.v = v; self.nxt = nxt

def swap_brute(values):
    if len(values) < 2: return values
    head = N(values[0])
    cur = head
    for v in values[1:]:
        cur.nxt = N(v); cur = cur.nxt
    dummy = N(0, head)
    prev = dummy
    while prev.nxt and prev.nxt.nxt:
        a = prev.nxt
        b = a.nxt
        prev.nxt = b
        a.nxt = b.nxt
        b.nxt = a
        prev = a
    out = []
    cur = dummy.nxt
    while cur:
        out.append(cur.v); cur = cur.nxt
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        print(); sys.exit(0)
    n = int(data[0])
    vals = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    print(' '.join(map(str, swap_brute(vals))))

solutions.idea: 直观指针操作：先记录 next，再交换 prev→next/next→prev 等。逻辑比 dummy 写法稍繁琐但不依赖额外虚拟头，是另一种“动手派”写法。
solutions.code:
import sys

class N:
    __slots__ = ('v', 'nxt')
    def __init__(self, v=0, nxt=None):
        self.v = v; self.nxt = nxt

def swap_opt(values):
    head = None
    for v in reversed(values):
        head = N(v, head)
    if head is None or head.nxt is None:
        return values
    dummy = N(0, head)
    prev = dummy
    while prev.nxt and prev.nxt.nxt:
        a = prev.nxt
        b = a.nxt
        nxt = b.nxt
        prev.nxt = b
        b.nxt = a
        a.nxt = nxt
        prev = a
    out = []
    cur = dummy.nxt
    while cur:
        out.append(cur.v); cur = cur.nxt
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        print(); sys.exit(0)
    n = int(data[0])
    vals = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    print(' '.join(map(str, swap_opt(vals))))

solutions.idea: 递归：对每两个节点 a、b，交换它们并递归处理 b.next；基准为空或单节点。O(L) 时间、O(L) 递归栈空间。代码最短，仅 k=2 的特例下常数比迭代略优。
